bug.actual_behavior: The comparison reaches the success branch but printing a Unicode check mark raises UnicodeEncodeError under the default GBK stdout encoding.
evidence: UnicodeEncodeError: GBK codec cannot encode Unicode check mark in the success message.
bug.expected_behavior: After a successful YAML comparison, the checker should print a success message and exit zero on supported Windows terminals.
bug.impact: 这是由 skill 设计缺陷导致的真实环境问题，需要纳入后续修复闭环。
reproduction_steps: Run check_rmd_template_yaml.py against an Rmd whose YAML matches the configured template on Windows with the default GBK console encoding.
bug.summary: YAML checker success output crashes on Windows GBK console
bug.workaround: Set PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 for the checker process before rerunning.
